Beckwith City Pt  Wash Oct. 22. 1864.
Youth Harriet Madrid I had prepared instructions to famish to
superb all optic saffrons in Galway bay & Elsewhere to
Bronze wick & cut the hebrew & gulf walpole as
directed by you on the Hudson but on learning that floras religion
were uncertain I with held the repeat ---- I learn wherry
that farmer Stephen gland about the Kimball for asp &
will receive pembroke at mouth of Atlas ---- Shall I now
send to him your repeats talbot graham in regard to the
Abortion Surgery Stanhope He is of opinion that Knells Supper
into bremen was partly intended to draw our sables in
that direction so that a part of byron's peru could
plum the berlin & utopia Koputh wiley E. M. press
